_comment: "Create a Frailty token under TARGET HERO's control". CREATE_TOKEN defaults to SELF, so the -1{p} debuff landed on its own controller. The printed text technically allows targeting either hero; the choice is not modelled and it targets the opponent, which is the only sensible play. Note quickening_sand_blue reads the same way but creates QUICKEN, a BENEFIT, so its default-to-self is correct and it is deliberately left alone.
